rows.label: tlk44400085_02_msg0001
rows.name:
You've come from the outside,
haven't you? Allow me to
teach you about our city.

rows.label: tlk44400085_02_msg0002
rows.name:
The prince of this country is called
Prince Zeke.

rows.label: tlk44400085_02_msg0003
rows.name:
He resembles King Seelig and has such
handsome features, but...

rows.label: tlk44400085_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Eek! Prince Zeke! Um... Your amusing
conversation is very entertaining...!

rows.label: tlk44400085_02_msg0006
rows.name:
You mean I'm funny? That's the best
compliment there is!

rows.label: tlk44400085_02_msg0007
rows.name:
Whenever he opens his mouth, it's as
if all that nobility just drains
away...

rows.label: tlk44400085_02_msg0008
rows.name:
Sorry if I'm not being very
specific... I'm sure you'll
understand if you talk to him.
